page_title: WER 1-0 UNI | Werder Bremen v Union Berlin 24/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Tom Rothe (Union Berlin), who has already been caught several times today.
90+6' Woo-Yeong Jeong sends the corner to the centre of the box where Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) leaps highest but pushes his header well wide of the left post.
90+6' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90+5' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Union Berlin win a corner.
90+4' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
90+3' We are about to witness a subsitution. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) for Romano Schmid.
90+2' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+2' Corner kicks – 5:5.
90+2' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
90+1' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Horst Steffen has decided to substitute Yukinari Sugawara and he is replaced by Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen).
90' Substitution. Marco Grull makes his way off the pitch and Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) comes on as his replacement.
88' Mio Backhaus had to pull off an exquisite save to thwart a knuckleball from Tim Skarke (Union Berlin), even though it only went towards the middle of the target.
86' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
85' Horst Steffen decides to make a substitution. Samuel Mbangula will be replaced by Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen).
85' It will be a substitution. Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) is ready to enter the pitch as Victor Boniface walks off.
84' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) serves up a nice cross, but Mio Backhaus punches the ball away.
83' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
80' The game is interrupted now, Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
79' Here is a change. Diogo Leite is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin).
79' The substitution is prepared. Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Christopher Trimmel.
79' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
75' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
74' No offside! Referee Daniel Schlager points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Werder Bremen players.
73' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Werder Bremen players aren’t happy.
72' 1 - 0 GOAL! Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) got to the ball in front of the goal and he couldn't miss from there. His strike went in off the crossbar. The score is 1:0.

71' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends in a cross from a free kick from just outside the box, trying to find one of his teammates deep inside the penalty area. The goalkeeper displays great anticipation and collects the ball.
70' It's like he was asking for a caution. Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) receives a yellow card.
68' 14:10 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 2:1.
68' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) offside.
67' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

67' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the right post.
66' Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Union Berlin are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
65' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Daniel Schlager who sees an offensive foul.
62' Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted!
61' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniel Schlager signals. Werder Bremen have a free kick from a promising distance.
61' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) replacing Derrick Kohn.
61' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aljoscha Kemlein.
60' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
59' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
58' Referee Daniel Schlager sees the trip by Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Werder Bremen.
57' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

56' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. The ball goes out of play. Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
56' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag and Werder Bremen will take a corner.
53' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off his line to gather the ball.
53' Werder Bremen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
52' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
51' A crossfield pass from Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) fails to find any of his teammates.
49' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Victor Boniface picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.

47' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Great chance! Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar.
47' Neat passing move from Union Berlin in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Christopher Trimmel sends a lovely ball from the corner into the path of Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin), whose close-range header flashes just wide of the left post.
45+2' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) prepares to take a corner kick.
45+1' The ball is cleared after Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Good work from Union Berlin as they win a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) receives the ball from Samuel Mbangula and tries to beat the keeper from long range, but the effort goes high over the bar.
45' A nice individual effort by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
44' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mio Backhaus, who smothers the ball.
43' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!

42' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
41' Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) sends a long cross over to Samuel Mbangula, but Frederik Ronnow comes forward to gather the ball.
37' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
36' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
31' 6:7 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. 2:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
29' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Steffen Baumgart has decided that Tim Skarke is the man to take his place.
28' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
27' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Frederik Ronnow was alert and made a comfortable save.
27' Half-chance! Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) plays a pass into the box, but Frederik Ronnow reacts well to snuff out the attack.
25' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mio Backhaus intercepts the ball.
23' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Daniel Schlager didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' A dangerous looking corner kick from Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is cleared to safety by the defence.
22' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Werder Bremen force their opponents to concede a corner.
20' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.

19' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant. Union Berlin force a corner. They send men into the box.
18' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 70:30.
15' Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) controls a rebound and tries to catch the keeper out from long range, but it's a poor effort that sails well wide of the right post.
15' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) tries to play a long through ball into Victor Boniface, but the defence breaks the move down.
14' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
14' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out for a corner. Union Berlin can continue in their attacking effort.
12' Christopher Trimmel pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar.
12' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

12' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Mio Backhaus makes a great save to stop his effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Union Berlin.
11' Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
10' The corner from Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is intercepted by the defence.
8' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
7' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort.
6' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle after Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Werder Bremen win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
3' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
3' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

3' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Daniel Schlager will referee today's match.
